title: Hunters report total silence just before a companion vanished

tellings.quote: And the ones who come back saying right before he disappeared, right before Charlie disappeared, there was no sound.

plain: Hunters in the American wilderness say that just before a companion named Charlie vanished, everything went completely silent. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from Missing 411, accounts gathered by a researcher named David Pitus of people who disappeared without a trace in the wild, and the silence is offered as a clue that something unusual took them.
